get.description:
Fuzzy-searches StoreVendors and Vendors by first/last name, shop name or phone and returns up to 5 of each with their available credit points. Used by the finance returns screen to pick the vendor whose credits are being refunded.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check — the deny-by-default middleware requires an admin session for this route. Wrapped handlers on this file use withAuditLog, which only logs (it does not enforce auth).

_Source: `app/api/finance/returns/credits/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term matched against firstName, lastName, shopName and phoneNumber. Returns 400 if missing.

post.summary: Refund all credits of a vendor
post.description:
Zeroes the vendor's creditsAvailable (StoreVendors first, then Vendors) and writes a FinanceReturnLog row of type CREDIT with amount = oldCredits * 10. Mutates money-equivalent balances.

**Notes:** Side effect: sets creditsAvailable to 0 for the vendor and creates a FinanceReturnLog entry. Audit-logged via withAuditLog (entity FINANCE) but NOT auth-protected.

_Source: `app/api/finance/returns/credits/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

get.summary: Get gift-card payout value for a lead
get.description:
Mirrors the backend's authoritative gift-card payout amount for a lead. Requires an admin next-auth session and forwards the session accessToken to GET {BACKEND_API}/admin/gift-cards/value/{leadId} using the admin gateway header triple.

**Notes:** Upstream: BACKEND_API || NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL (fallback http://backend.internal:8083/api/v1) + /admin/gift-cards/value/{leadId}. Needs the admin gateway triple (x-admin-request + x-internal-service-token + the admin's own JWT) — a plain BACKEND_ADMIN_TOKEN bearer is rejected upstream. The amount is owned by the backend and must not be recomputed here.

_Source: `app/api/gift-cards/value/[leadId]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

200.description: Upstream gift-card value (status is proxied from upstream)

patch.summary: Accept a review proof and refund credits
patch.description:
Accepts a pending vendor review proof and, in one transaction, credits the configured percentage of the order's creditPoints to the vendor's wallet with a matching VendorCreditLogs ledger entry.

**Notes:** Mutates money: credits the vendor wallet using the active ReviewRefundConfig percentage (0 when inactive). Also sends a best-effort VENDOR_REVIEW_APPROVED push. Wrapped in withAuditLog (VENDOR). No request body is read.

_Source: `app/api/review-refunds/[id]/accept/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

reason.description: Why the device is being returned

vendorId.description: Vendor id whose payments are fetched

id.description: ExcessBuyback item id; must be InStock

paymentMethod.description: Cash / Bank / UPI — appended to the log description

SuccessMessageEnvelope.description: Envelope `{ success, message }`; `success` is `true` on 2xx and `false` on error responses.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
